The '''Rebel cell''' from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] '''[[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]''' were anti-[[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] resistance movement led by [[Mak Pra]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:Shu Mai and guard.png|left|thumb|170x170px|Shu Mai Presidente of the Commerce Guild on Felucia.]]
After many months of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucians]] decided to form their own resistance movement [[Rebellion on Felucia|against]] the malicious workings of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent its contact [[Mak Pra]], who reported on the current situation on the planet [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], including the dispatch of several [[Republic trooper|Republic soldiers]] and [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]].<ref name="Kinect" />

When [[Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], they decided to help local rebels drive the Shu Mai forces from the planet. The next day, they launched an attack on [[Shu Mai's fortress]]. [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] losses were so heavy that Shu Mai had to evacuate from Felucia.<ref name="Kinect" />
